philosophy: Every invariant that matters financially should be expressed as executable code.

invariants.name: Money Commutativity and Format Roundtrip
invariants.requirement: Minor unit integer preservation and shuffle invariance
invariants.risk: Silent floating-point truncation or currency precision drift

invariants.name: Over-Refund Contradiction Gate
invariants.requirement: Refunds exceeding captured amount must never contest
invariants.risk: Falsely contesting a dispute where customer refund was legitimately owed

invariants.name: Currency Homogeneity Invariant
invariants.requirement: Currency mismatch between claim, capture, and refund prevents contest
invariants.risk: Unhedged FX exposure and fraudulent currency claims

invariants.name: Point-in-Time Temporal Evidence Isolation
invariants.requirement: Evidence dated after decision timestamp is inadmissible
invariants.risk: Lookahead data leakage and corrupted historical audit trails

invariants.name: Metamorphic Historical Replay Invariance
invariants.requirement: Adding future evidence must never alter earlier decision replay

invariants.name: External Ingestion Idempotency
invariants.requirement: Processing same external event ID N times results in 1 state mutation
invariants.risk: Duplicate ledger entries, double decisions, or double counting

invariants.name: Worker Lease Exclusivity and Stale Rejection
invariants.requirement: Stale worker holding expired lease cannot overwrite newer valid result
invariants.risk: Split-brain decision conflicts under network partitions or worker stalls

invariants.name: Zero Feature Label Leakage
invariants.requirement: Zero target-derived or outcome tokens in feature manifests
invariants.risk: Artificially inflated benchmark metrics via data leakage

invariants.name: Dataset Split Disjointness
invariants.requirement: Strict zero-overlap between train, dev, and holdout splits
invariants.formal_expression: Train intersect Dev == empty and Train intersect Holdout == empty
invariants.risk: Data contamination and test set memorization

invariants.name: Monotonic Selective Prediction Coverage
invariants.requirement: Widening confidence intervals monotonically increases review rate
invariants.risk: Uncontrolled automation expansion into uncertain territory

invariants.name: Out-of-Distribution Safe Routing
invariants.requirement: Severe distribution shifts route 100% of cases to review
invariants.risk: Confident hallucinations on novel fraud or transaction patterns

invariants.name: Formal Proof Dominance
invariants.requirement: SMT UNSAT contradiction strictly dominates probabilistic model pass
invariants.formal_expression: Z3_UNSAT ==> Decision == BLOCK regardless of p_ml
invariants.risk: Statistical model overriding a provable arithmetic contradiction

invariants.name: Grounding and Provenance Hash Integrity
invariants.requirement: 1-byte document modification alters hash; ambiguous quotes fail closed
invariants.formal_expression: Doc != Doc' ==> Hash(Doc) != Hash(Doc') and Count(Quote) > 1 ==> AMBIGUOUS
invariants.risk: Ungrounded model hallucinations treated as authoritative evidence

invariants.name: Technical Failure Fails Closed
invariants.requirement: Extractor, solver, or DB timeout degrades to REVIEW, never PASS
invariants.risk: Service outages falsely auto-submitting unverified disputes

invariants.name: AST Zero Razorpay Payment Mutation
invariants.requirement: Zero payment write or mutation APIs in abstract syntax tree
invariants.risk: Accidental monetary transfer originating from verification gateway

invariants.name: Constant-Time HMAC Authentication
invariants.requirement: Any payload tampering or secret mismatch rejected without timing leak
invariants.risk: Forged external webhooks injecting false dispute claims
